headline: Five smallcap mutual funds deliver up to 20% annualized returns in three years
hook: Smallcap returns split between 20% and single digits
summary: Five small-cap mutual funds delivered annualized returns of up to 20.1% over the past three years, led by Bandhan Small Cap Fund. In contrast, five other schemes posted much lower single-digit returns ranging from 7.6% to 8.2% during the same period. This performance gap highlights wide return dispersions among active fund managers in the smallcap segment. Indian retail investors reviewing their equity mutual fund portfolios should check if their smallcap schemes are lagging or leading peers.
why_it_matters: Your smallcap mutual fund returns may vary widely from peers
winners_losers: Bandhan Small Cap holders gain / laggard scheme investors trail

headline: Equity mutual fund SIPs delivered positive returns over 5- and 7-year periods
hook: Zero equity funds lost money over time
summary: An analysis of equity mutual funds found that no scheme delivered negative SIP returns over five- and seven-year investment horizons. Quant Small Cap Fund led the seven-year category with a 24.59% return, while Bandhan Small Cap Fund topped the five-year category at 18.08%. Shriram Flexi Cap Fund recorded the lowest returns across both timeframes. This data demonstrates the wealth creation potential of long-term systematic investment plans for retail investors.
why_it_matters: Long-term SIP discipline protects your capital against market volatility.
winners_losers: Long-term SIP investors gain / panic sellers hurt

headline: Bandhan Mutual Fund buys 2.04% stake in EPL Limited
hook: Bandhan MF increases stake in EPL Limited
summary: Bandhan Mutual Fund has acquired a 2.04% equity stake in packaging company EPL Limited. The transaction was executed through open market operations. This move reflects institutional interest in the company's stock. Retail investors should note that institutional buying often signals confidence in a company's long-term growth prospects.
why_it_matters: Institutional buying may provide price support for EPL shares.

headline: Bandhan Small Cap leads five mutual funds with over 16% three-year returns
hook: Small cap funds deliver 16% three-year returns
summary: Five smallcap mutual funds delivered over 16 percent annualised returns across a three-year period. Bandhan Small Cap Fund led the group with 21.2 percent annualised returns. The performance figures highlight divergence across smallcap schemes as retail investors evaluate deployment opportunities in the segment.
why_it_matters: Compare your smallcap fund returns against category benchmarks
